name: Revenue Leak
tagline: Practical revenue leakage research for operators and founders.
bio: Revenue Leak publishes actionable guidance on revenue leakage, funnel performance, and billing recovery for SaaS, ecommerce, agency, and service businesses. Articles and the diagnostic use a structured six-category framework and published industry benchmarks—designed to help teams prioritize fixes quickly.
credentials: Six-category leakage framework covering acquisition, response, conversion, retention, billing, and expansion
Benchmarks aligned with widely cited industry ranges and funnel performance metrics
Documented questionnaire-based methodology with transparent scoring assumptions
Content aligned with the Revenue Leak diagnostic for consistent guidance across the site

methodology.title: Structured framework
methodology.text: Every article maps to one or more stages of the customer journey—so readers can connect advice to measurable funnel steps.

methodology.title: Benchmark-driven
methodology.text: Guidance references published ranges and operator best practices rather than anecdote, with clear steps to estimate dollar impact from your own numbers.

methodology.title: Action-first
methodology.text: Recommendations are ranked by estimated impact and implementation effort, matching the prioritization logic in the Revenue Leak diagnostic.

disclaimer: Revenue Leak provides directional estimates and educational content. It is not a substitute for formal financial, legal, tax, or audit advice. Always validate material decisions with qualified professionals.
